name: zastech
summary: Small pay-once browser tools and prepaid APIs for invoices, proposals, Etsy payouts, bank statements, CSV cleanup and document extraction.
best_for: Online sellers, freelancers and small teams that want a single finished job done, such as an invoice or an Etsy payout breakdown, and prefer to pay once instead of per month
skip_if: you need full bookkeeping or payroll, you want one shared workspace for a whole team, you cannot test a tool with your own file first, or you want a tool we have tested ourselves
honest_knock: Each tool does one narrow job, so a business that needs full accounting still needs separate software. A license covers up to three browsers and files live on your device, so there is no shared team workspace unless you buy a team plan. The privacy claim comes from the vendor and we have not checked it. The catalogue is new and we have no buyer reports.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-15 on zastech.dev/pricing, US dollars) zastech sells small browser tools and developer APIs. Invoice Maker, Proposal Builder and Client Report Builder are free forever with a small zastech footer, and removing it costs a one-time $9, $15 and $19. Every other browser tool gives three free results with no signup, then a one-time license: Etsy Payout Breakdown, Bank Statement Converter and Data Reconciliation Studio cost $29; Payout Audit, Contract Workspace, Invoice & Receipt Extractor, AR Aging Analyzer, PDF Redactor and Spreadsheet Diff cost $19; CSV Cleaner & Mapper costs $15. A license works on up to three browsers and has no renewal. Developer APIs are prepaid packs of $15 or $19 for 10,000 to 20,000 requests and never renew. The Freelancer Kit (four tools) costs $39 once and the Finance Ops Kit (five tools) $79 once; team plans of 10 or 25 people cost more. Checkout is by Lemon Squeezy, which adds tax. We have not paid for a license.

schema_offer.description: Single browser tool (CSV Cleaner & Mapper), Free tools stay free with a footer; white-label Invoice Maker $9, Proposal Builder $15, Client Report Builder $19 once; other browser tools $15 to $29 once after 3 free results; API packs $15 to $19 prepaid; Freelancer Kit $39 once; Finance Ops Kit $79 once; Starter Kit $99; USD, tax at checkout. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-11-15.

exit_test.what: No account was needed; the tool ran without signing in. On 18 November 2026 the session tested two zastech tools without an account. The free Invoice Maker made a two line invoice of $938.00 in about 2 minutes, with a live preview, local drafts and a small footer Created with zastech.dev that stays in print unless you pay $9. The PDF Redactor & Sanitizer showed the metadata of a made up test PDF and let us draw black boxes by hand (no automatic detection; the first try failed and one box was a few pixels off), with 3 free outputs counted on the server of zastech. The sanitized PDF was not downloaded, so the removal of the text was not verified. Nothing was bought. Account and start: NO account was made and none was used. The tools of zastech run in the browser without signing in; our AI assistant ran the test in our own tab of our browser, starting at 13:15. Nothing was installed and no e-mail address, phone number, password or card was typed in anywhere. The dossier name is zastech and the review is on OSM (zastech-review). Core action 1, Invoice Maker (zastech.dev/tools/invoice-maker): the page says you can create and save a professional invoice without an account, with unlimited free exports and no signup, and shows the cards No account required, A4 PDF unlimited free and Drafts stay on this device. It was filled with made up data: seller Example Snowboards Ltd, buyer Sample Store Inc., currency USD (the default) and two lines, Freestyle snowboard 2 x $349.00 = $698.00 and Snowboard bindings 2 x $120.00 = $240.00. The live preview showed Subtotal $938.00 and Total $938.00, which is the right sum. A usable invoice was on screen about 2 minutes after the page was opened, with one form and two lines; the fields were filled by a script and not typed, so typing by hand takes a little longer. The preview updates while you type, without a generate button. Footer: the free invoice carries the line Created with zastech.dev, free invoice maker, small and light grey at the bottom, and the print style sheet of the page always shows this block in print. The buttons are New, Save, History, Remove branding $9, License / Activate and Print / Save PDF. Saving is local (Draft saved locally, Private, saved only on this device). Document type (Invoice or Estimate / Quote) and Upload logo (PNG, JPG or WebP, at most 150 KB) are free. The print preview and the PDF export itself were NOT opened: the print dialog of Chrome cannot be operated by the browser tool and nothing was to be saved on our laptop. The print style sheet was read: it hides the header, the editor and the buttons and leaves only the invoice. Core action 2, PDF Redactor & Sanitizer (zastech.dev/tools/pdf-redactor-sanitizer): the cards say Flattened into page pixels, Original metadata not copied and PDF stays in this browser. A made up test invoice of 2 KB and 2 pages was uploaded with the file picker; it holds a made up buyer line with a contact e-mail address and a phone number. The inspection panel showed Pages 2, Metadata fields 7, Attachments 0 and JavaScript actions 0, plus the original metadata (title, author, creator, producer, creation date and more). Redaction is MANUAL: you drag across the preview to create a black box and click a box to remove it. There is no automatic detection of e-mail addresses or phone numbers. The first try failed (the page moved about 100 pixels during the drag and the boxes landed above the line); Clear page redactions said Page redactions cleared. The second try made 2 boxes and the counter said 2 redactions. The box over the phone number starts a few pixels too far right, so the first letter of the word phone sticks out. In the preview the boxes are half transparent and the text shows through; the site says the export is flattened into pixels. Download sanitized PDF was NOT clicked, because it would save a file on our laptop and use one free result. So whether the text is really gone from the output was not verified. Free results: the Trial / License window said Free outputs available and 3 free outputs left, no signup needed; the small print says 3 free sanitized exports need no signup, free outputs are counted on the server of zastech, and a paid license unlocks unlimited sanitized exports on up to 3 browser activations. So the counter lives on the server, next to the claim that the PDF stays in the browser; the network traffic was not inspected. Plans: The pricing page zastech.dev/pricing was read on 18 Nov 2026 by the tester and read again just before this delivery the same day, with the same prices: Free forever, $0 always, with a small zastech footer, for Invoice Maker, Proposal Builder and Client Report Builder; white-label, once, Invoice Maker $9, Proposal Builder $15 and Client Report Builder $19; the other browser tools give 3 free results and then cost $15 to $29 once (PDF Redactor & Sanitizer $19), no subscription or renewal, up to three browsers per license; API packs $15 or $19 prepaid; Freelancer Kit $39 once (Invoice Maker, Proposal Builder, Contract Workspace and Client Report Builder; team of 10 $149, team of 25 $299), Finance Ops Kit $79 once and Starter Kit $99. Prices are in USD and any sales tax or VAT is shown at checkout by Lemon Squeezy before you pay. The dossier matches the pricing page; the PDF Redactor at $19 falls within its range of $15 to $29. The checkout of Lemon Squeezy was NOT opened and nothing was filled in. Cancelling: there is no account and no subscription, so there was nothing to cancel. Not tested: the print preview and a real PDF export of the Invoice Maker; the download of the sanitized PDF and a check that the text is really removed from the file; white-label ($9) and every paid license and payment screen; the API packs (the developers group); Etsy Payout Breakdown, which needs real statements; Proposal Builder and Client Report Builder. Clean up: there is no account and no file was saved on the laptop (no download). The invoice draft sits only in the local browser storage of the test tab (Draft saved locally). All our own tabs were closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The free invoice carries a small zastech footer that the print style sheet always shows, so a clean invoice costs $9 once. Redaction is fully manual: there is no detection of e-mail addresses or phone numbers, the page moved during our first drag, and one box ended a few pixels short, which you only see if you look closely. The boxes look half transparent in the preview, and we could not check that the downloaded file is clean. The site says the PDF stays in the browser, while the free outputs are counted on its server.

sessions.what: No account was needed; the tool ran without signing in. On 18 November 2026 the session tested two zastech tools without an account. The free Invoice Maker made a two line invoice of $938.00 in about 2 minutes, with a live preview, local drafts and a small footer Created with zastech.dev that stays in print unless you pay $9. The PDF Redactor & Sanitizer showed the metadata of a made up test PDF and let us draw black boxes by hand (no automatic detection; the first try failed and one box was a few pixels off), with 3 free outputs counted on the server of zastech. The sanitized PDF was not downloaded, so the removal of the text was not verified. Nothing was bought.
findings: Text we checked: "No account required". What we saw: Both the Invoice Maker and the PDF Redactor ran in the browser without signing in; no e-mail address, phone number, password or card was asked at any point of the test.

Text we checked: "Professional documents with a small zastech footer". What we saw: The free invoice shows Created with zastech.dev, free invoice maker at the bottom in small light grey text, and the print style sheet always shows this block in print. Removing it costs $9 once (Remove branding $9).

Text we checked: "Subtotal $938.00". What we saw: Two made up lines (2 x $349.00 and 2 x $120.00) gave $698.00 and $240.00 and the preview showed Subtotal $938.00 and Total $938.00, the right sum, about 2 minutes after the page was opened. The fields were filled by a script, so typing by hand takes a little longer.

Text we checked: "Drag across the preview to create a black redaction. Click an existing black box to remove it". What we saw: Redaction is manual with no detection of e-mail addresses or phone numbers. The first try failed because the page moved about 100 pixels during the drag; after Clear page redactions the second try made 2 boxes, but the box over the phone number started a few pixels too far right and the first letter of the word phone stuck out.

Text we checked: "3 free results on every tool, then a lifetime license". What we saw: The PDF Redactor showed Free outputs available and 3 free outputs left with no signup, and a paid license unlocks unlimited exports on up to 3 browser activations, as on the pricing page.

Export and reimport.

exit_test.what: No account was needed; the tool ran without signing in. On 18 November 2026 the session tested two zastech tools without an account. The free Invoice Maker made a two line invoice of $938.00 in about 2 minutes, with a live preview, local drafts and a small footer Created with zastech.dev that stays in print unless you pay $9. The PDF Redactor & Sanitizer showed the metadata of a made up test PDF and let us draw black boxes by hand (no automatic detection; the first try failed and one box was a few pixels off), with 3 free outputs counted on the server of zastech. The sanitized PDF was not downloaded, so the removal of the text was not verified. Nothing was bought. Account and start: NO account was made and none was used. The tools of zastech run in the browser without signing in; our AI assistant ran the test in our own tab of our browser, starting at 13:15. Nothing was installed and no e-mail address, phone number, password or card was typed in anywhere. The dossier name is zastech and the review is on OSM (zastech-review). Core action 1, Invoice Maker (zastech.dev/tools/invoice-maker): the page says you can create and save a professional invoice without an account, with unlimited free exports and no signup, and shows the cards No account required, A4 PDF unlimited free and Drafts stay on this device. It was filled with made up data: seller Example Snowboards Ltd, buyer Sample Store Inc., currency USD (the default) and two lines, Freestyle snowboard 2 x $349.00 = $698.00 and Snowboard bindings 2 x $120.00 = $240.00. The live preview showed Subtotal $938.00 and Total $938.00, which is the right sum. A usable invoice was on screen about 2 minutes after the page was opened, with one form and two lines; the fields were filled by a script and not typed, so typing by hand takes a little longer. The preview updates while you type, without a generate button. Footer: the free invoice carries the line Created with zastech.dev, free invoice maker, small and light grey at the bottom, and the print style sheet of the page always shows this block in print. The buttons are New, Save, History, Remove branding $9, License / Activate and Print / Save PDF. Saving is local (Draft saved locally, Private, saved only on this device). Document type (Invoice or Estimate / Quote) and Upload logo (PNG, JPG or WebP, at most 150 KB) are free. The print preview and the PDF export itself were NOT opened: the print dialog of Chrome cannot be operated by the browser tool and nothing was to be saved on our laptop. The print style sheet was read: it hides the header, the editor and the buttons and leaves only the invoice. Core action 2, PDF Redactor & Sanitizer (zastech.dev/tools/pdf-redactor-sanitizer): the cards say Flattened into page pixels, Original metadata not copied and PDF stays in this browser. A made up test invoice of 2 KB and 2 pages was uploaded with the file picker; it holds a made up buyer line with a contact e-mail address and a phone number. The inspection panel showed Pages 2, Metadata fields 7, Attachments 0 and JavaScript actions 0, plus the original metadata (title, author, creator, producer, creation date and more). Redaction is MANUAL: you drag across the preview to create a black box and click a box to remove it. There is no automatic detection of e-mail addresses or phone numbers. The first try failed (the page moved about 100 pixels during the drag and the boxes landed above the line); Clear page redactions said Page redactions cleared. The second try made 2 boxes and the counter said 2 redactions. The box over the phone number starts a few pixels too far right, so the first letter of the word phone sticks out. In the preview the boxes are half transparent and the text shows through; the site says the export is flattened into pixels. Download sanitized PDF was NOT clicked, because it would save a file on our laptop and use one free result. So whether the text is really gone from the output was not verified. Free results: the Trial / License window said Free outputs available and 3 free outputs left, no signup needed; the small print says 3 free sanitized exports need no signup, free outputs are counted on the server of zastech, and a paid license unlocks unlimited sanitized exports on up to 3 browser activations. So the counter lives on the server, next to the claim that the PDF stays in the browser; the network traffic was not inspected. Plans: The pricing page zastech.dev/pricing was read on 18 Nov 2026 by the tester and read again just before this delivery the same day, with the same prices: Free forever, $0 always, with a small zastech footer, for Invoice Maker, Proposal Builder and Client Report Builder; white-label, once, Invoice Maker $9, Proposal Builder $15 and Client Report Builder $19; the other browser tools give 3 free results and then cost $15 to $29 once (PDF Redactor & Sanitizer $19), no subscription or renewal, up to three browsers per license; API packs $15 or $19 prepaid; Freelancer Kit $39 once (Invoice Maker, Proposal Builder, Contract Workspace and Client Report Builder; team of 10 $149, team of 25 $299), Finance Ops Kit $79 once and Starter Kit $99. Prices are in USD and any sales tax or VAT is shown at checkout by Lemon Squeezy before you pay. The dossier matches the pricing page; the PDF Redactor at $19 falls within its range of $15 to $29. The checkout of Lemon Squeezy was NOT opened and nothing was filled in. Cancelling: there is no account and no subscription, so there was nothing to cancel. Not tested: the print preview and a real PDF export of the Invoice Maker; the download of the sanitized PDF and a check that the text is really removed from the file; white-label ($9) and every paid license and payment screen; the API packs (the developers group); Etsy Payout Breakdown, which needs real statements; Proposal Builder and Client Report Builder. Clean up: there is no account and no file was saved on the laptop (no download). The invoice draft sits only in the local browser storage of the test tab (Draft saved locally). All our own tabs were closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The free invoice carries a small zastech footer that the print style sheet always shows, so a clean invoice costs $9 once. Redaction is fully manual: there is no detection of e-mail addresses or phone numbers, the page moved during our first drag, and one box ended a few pixels short, which you only see if you look closely. The boxes look half transparent in the preview, and we could not check that the downloaded file is clean. The site says the PDF stays in the browser, while the free outputs are counted on its server.
